How to approach the Speaking Subtest
Return to Speaking Subtest Main Menu
There are a number of resources available to build up your knowledge of the particular expectations of the Speaking Sub-test.
Suggested test strategies - see: Sitting the Speaking sub-test - some strategies andSitting the Speaking sub-test - common mistakes.
Examples of roleplaysOn the following pages, we provide:
• an analysis of a sample test roleplay card for each profession• a recording of a sample roleplay with an accompanying model assessment based on the assessment criteria• a recording of a sample roleplay for each profession with an accompanying task to raise awareness of the assessment criteria. 
Note: To get a clearer sense of the range of acceptable language performance, we suggest you listen to roleplays for all professions.Examples available on the OET websiteThe OET website contains many resources for candidates.For specific examples of role-plays (unfortunately only doctor and nurse samples) on the OET website, follow this link.
